entities.summary: Blessed Berardo dei Marsi was a Catholic Italian cardinal born in unknown year, died on November 10, 1130. He played a significant role in the Catholic Church during the Medieval period, contributing to the development of religious doctrine and practices. Berardo dei Marsi was proclaimed Blessed in 1802 as he was deemed to be holy and that miracles were performed through his intercession. His legacy continues to influence Catholicism to this day, particularly in the Italian region of Marsi, where he was revered as a local saint.
